heading: Today
text: Sun, mixed with some clouds this morning, then mostly sunny.  Quite warm.  Highs in the 60s to low 70s, a few record mid 70s in the warmer valleys.  Winds south to southwest near 10 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear through midnight, then increasing clouds from the west late.  Mild.  Lows in the 40s to near 50 east, and low to mid 50s west.  Winds south to southwest near 10 mph, becoming light in wind-sheltered valleys, gusting to 30 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Some early sun east, then mostly cloudy.  Showers developing in NY and the St. Lawrence, spreading east but becoming scattered midday and afternoon.  Highs in the 60s.  South to southwest winds 10 to 15 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 35 mph from the Green Mountains west.
